text: Anndu gomɗinɓe goonguɓe ɓen ka gomɗinal maɓɓe, ko ɓen woni gomɗinɓe Alla ɓe gomɗini kadi Nulaaɗo Makko on, si ɓe laatike hiɓe wondi e Annabiijo on (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna) e fiyaake hawtinirɗo ɓe fii nafa Julɓe ɓen, ɓe yahatah haa ɓe ɗaɓɓira mo duŋayee fii yahugol. Pellet, ɓen ɗaɓɓirooɓe ma -an Nulaaɗo- duŋayee tuma yahugol ko ɓen ɗon gomɗini Alla, ɓe gomɗini Nulaaɗo Makko on e goonga, si ɓe ɗaɓɓirii ma duŋayee fii yoga e fiyaake hittuɗo e maɓɓe duŋano on mo yiɗuɗaa duŋanaade e maɓɓe, ɗaɓɓanaaɓe yawtaneede junubaaji ɗin. Pellet, Alla ko O Yawtoowo tububaaji kala tuubuɗo immorde jeyaaɓe makko ɓen, ko O Yurmeteeɗo ɓe.
